description: Delete backups of originals. DESTRUCTIVE: originals of cleaned images can no longer be restored. Needs exactly one scope: older_than_days (backups older than N days), ids (attachment ids, at most 500) or all: true (every backup). Returns { deleted, bytes, remaining, skipped }.

ids.description: Scope: attachment ids whose backups to delete, at most 500

older_than_days.description: Scope: delete backups older than this many days, 0..3650

name: media_cleanup_backups
